purpose: Govern core and vertical data model boundaries for PRISMA multi-business verticals.

coreEntities.name: Business
coreEntities.description: Identidad del negocio, regimen operativo, paquetes activos y politicas base.

coreEntities.name: Terminal
coreEntities.description: Dispositivo autorizado para operar localmente y generar eventos.

coreEntities.name: Operator
coreEntities.description: Persona o rol que ejecuta acciones sensibles en Tablet o PC.

coreEntities.name: Shift
coreEntities.description: Turno de caja local con apertura, cierre, cortes y resumen.

coreEntities.name: Product
coreEntities.description: Articulo vendible fisico base; no debe absorber servicios, mesas, recetas ni reparaciones.

coreEntities.name: Barcode
coreEntities.description: Codigo de lectura asociado a producto, variante o unidad de venta.

coreEntities.name: PriceRule
coreEntities.description: Regla basica de precio vigente, con alcance por negocio, terminal o vertical.

coreEntities.name: Sale
coreEntities.description: Ticket o venta cerrable localmente por Tablet.

coreEntities.name: SaleLine
coreEntities.description: Linea de venta con producto, servicio o item verticalizado normalizado.

coreEntities.name: Payment
coreEntities.description: Registro de metodo, monto, referencia y estado de pago.

coreEntities.name: Return
coreEntities.description: Operacion de devolucion total o parcial.

coreEntities.name: OutboxEvent
coreEntities.description: Evento local pendiente, enviado, fallido o reconocido.

coreEntities.name: AuditEntry
coreEntities.description: Rastro de accion sensible con actor, antes/despues y razon.

rules: Vertical-only fields must be modeled as extensions.
Tablet stores only what it needs to operate locally and safely.
PC governs advanced and cross-operation data.
A vertical extension must declare fixtures and acceptance criteria.
